field_checks.summary: Primary Table 1 contains 61 non-slash MIC cells across Met, Van, Dap, Nor, and YZ462. The current final activity layer contains 31 table records limited to Dap/YZ462 plus three Dap slash exclusions; Dap/YZ462 values reconcile exactly, but 30 non-slash Met/Van/Nor comparator MIC cells are neither final records nor source-backed exclusions.

Authoritative linked DBAASP/merged article, assay, literature, and sequence snapshots are all empty. The final database layer preserves two DBAASP machine fallback rows as one unresolved daptomycin candidate group, with source_verified_count 0 and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready false; this preserves the release boundary but remains a scientific caution.

The paper final and packet final directories contain the same six JSON artifacts and each mirrored artifact is byte-identical. Final counts reviewed: 31 activity records, 7 toxicity records, one database audit group, 7 mechanism claims, zero review rework targets, and zero live open rework tickets.

All 7 mechanism claims were reviewed against source locators. The final ontology keeps YZ462 direct evidence limited to membrane integrity/permeability, membrane potential/permeability, SEM morphology, and ITC interaction evidence; ROS and biofilm are phenotype_supported, and daptomycin remains unknown_or_not_tested rather than direct mechanism.

Primary XML/PDF identity matches PMC12606902, DOI 10.1186/s12866-025-04475-6, PMID 41219701, title, journal, and 2025 publication year. The scientific entity boundary remains cautioned because the paper is centered on small molecule YZ462, while local DBAASP fallback evidence concerns daptomycin comparator rows without authoritative linked database rows.

Activity MIC Dap/YZ462 locators are cell-level and value-faithful, but toxicity provenance is not field-level reliable. Final tox-03 and tox-04 use raw_value 6538 as a toxicity scalar from Fig. 1 panel locators even though 6538 is a strain token, not a cytotoxicity or hemolysis value; panel D is cytotoxicity and panel E is hemolysis. Final tox-05 through tox-07 encode Fig. S2 body-weight dose information as selectivity-index records, including mg/kg units for a ratio endpoint.

No recursive authority promotion was found in current finals. DBAASP fallback rows remain unresolved candidate machine evidence, source_verified_count is 0, authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false, and the strict acceptance artifact states the paper-level acceptance proof is not authoritative DBAASP ingest readiness.

No cross-database conflict is smoothed into source_verified, but unresolved database cautions are material: no authoritative linked rows exist and fallback candidate rows are not source-reviewable for sequence/modification identity. Those cautions are preserved and prevent authoritative ingest readiness.

Both staged supplements were inspected: MOESM1 is ASCII/tabular text with 458 rows, MOESM2 is a legacy DOC with antiword/docbook text, 10 tables, and a recovered CDX OLE text surface. Supplement extraction status reports material_extracted_complete, zero unparsed embedded objects, and no open material gap tickets.

Toxicity/selectivity coverage is not publication-grade. Source paragraph xml:p:33 reports cytotoxicity IC50 >38.08 uM (17.6 ug/mL), hemolysis IC50 6368.1 uM, and no acute toxicity at 100 mg/kg; Fig. S2 reports mouse body-weight observation after 25 or 50 mg/kg dosing. Current final toxicity rows instead include unsupported qualitative raw values, a false 6538 scalar, panel-swapped endpoints, and selectivity-index records not supported by the cited S2 locator.

blocking_findings.reason: Layer-2 final evidence is not publication-grade source-reviewable. Table 1 has 61 non-slash MIC cells across Met, Van, Dap, Nor, and YZ462, but the final layer records only the 31 Dap/YZ462 cells and gives no source-backed exclusion for 30 Met/Van/Nor comparator MIC cells. More severely, toxicity records PMC12606902-w2-tox-03 and PMC12606902-w2-tox-04 use 6538 as a toxicity scalar and swap/contradict Fig. 1D cytotoxicity versus Fig. 1E hemolysis semantics. Toxicity records PMC12606902-w2-tox-05 through tox-07 treat Fig. S2 body-weight/dose information as selectivity-index values, including mg/kg units for a ratio endpoint. The prior worker-2 toxicity unsupported-scalar ticket is marked closed, but the current final artifact still contains the source-level errors.
required_actions: Rebuild final activity_toxicity_evidence from the primary XML/PDF and supplement surfaces, not from closed-ticket summaries.
Account for every non-slash Table 1 MIC cell across Met, Van, Dap, Nor, and YZ462 as either an exact final activity row or a source-backed exclusion with explicit scope rationale.
Replace or remove tox-03 and tox-04; do not use 6538 as a toxicity scalar, and enforce Fig. 1D as cytotoxicity/cell viability and Fig. 1E as hemolysis.
Replace or remove tox-05 through tox-07; Fig. S2 supports mouse body-weight/no-acute-toxicity dose observations at 25 and 50 mg/kg, not selectivity-index values.
After repair, update both final mirrors and review evidence, and do not close the worker-2 rework lane until executable source checks pass.
acceptance_checks: Parse xml:table-wrap:1 and verify all 61 non-slash MIC cells are represented with exact value, unit, target, endpoint, and cell locator, or are covered by explicit source-backed exclusions; if the intended scientific scope is narrower, every omitted comparator cell must be excluded with a non-placeholder rationale.
For each toxicity_record, verify the raw_value appears in the cited locator as a scalar for that endpoint, not merely as an unrelated strain, dose, sample, panel, or page token.
Enforce endpoint-panel compatibility: Fig. 1D may support cytotoxicity/cell viability, Fig. 1E may support hemolysis, and swapped endpoints fail.
Reject selectivity-index records with mg/kg units or body-weight dose values unless a source locator explicitly reports a selectivity index ratio.
Verify paper and packet final activity_toxicity_evidence.json are byte-identical after repair and that live rework open-ticket counts still match final review/material status.

cautions.summary: Authoritative DBAASP/merged linked rows are absent. The current database final correctly keeps fallback daptomycin rows unresolved and excludes them from authoritative ingest, but this remains a preserved caution for downstream users.

Live rework requests are all closed and analysis/material status count zero open tickets. The final review_report has strict_gate.open_runtime_ticket_count=0 but no top-level open_rework_ticket_count field; this did not create the scientific FAIL, but future gate checks should keep the review-report count field explicit.
